title: Hermes image version
description: Pinned Hermes images. The Hermes analog of openclaw-version.schema.json. Unlike OpenClaw there is no legacy public image fallback — Hermes' base is a private fork, so only the extended ECR image (with per-env tags) is deployed.

upstream.description: Pinned base Hermes image+tag the Dockerfile FROMs — the Isol8 fork ghcr.io/isol8ai/hermes-agent (private GHCR package).

extendedImage.description: ECR repository URI for the custom extended Hermes image (without tag).

tag.description: Tag of the extended Hermes image deployed to dev.
Tag of the extended Hermes image deployed to prod.
